links.comparator_used: Keyword-only prompts with no plain-language instruction
links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT responses on fragility fractures (Flesch-Kincaid reading ease and grade level)
links.effect: FKRE median 34.35 with plain language prompts vs 23.60 with keyword-only prompts; FKGL median 12.05 vs 14.50; both differences statistically significant (Mann-Whitney U)
links.quote: The FKRE scores indicated significantly higher readability with plain language prompts (median 34.35) compared to keyword-only prompts (median 23.60).

design_hint: prompt wording (plain-language prompts) to improve readability
